-त्रम् 
__1 A parasol, an umbrella; अदेयमासीत् त्रयमेव भूपतेः शशिप्रभं छत्रमुभे च चामरे [[

.]] 
__2 Concealing the fault of one's teacher. 
-Comp. 
-घरः, -धारः the bearer of an umbrella. 
-धारण 
__1 carrying [Page0717-a2] or bearing an umbrella; [[

.]] 
__2 carrying an umbrella as a type of royal authority. 
-पतिः 
__1 a king over whom an umbrella is carried as a mark of dignity, a sovereign, emperor. 
__2 N. of an ancient king in जम्बुद्वीप. 
-भङ्गः 
__1 ‘destruction of the royal parasol’, loss of dominion, deposition. 
__2 dependence. 
__3 wilfulness. 
__4 a forlorn condition, widowhood.

[छत्रं गुरोर्वैगुण्यावरणं शीलमस्य [[Sk.]]; छत्रा° ण] A pupil, disciple. 
-त्रम् A kind of honey. 
-Comp. 
-गण्डः an indifferent poetical scholar, knowing only the beginnings of stanzas. 
-दर्शनम् fresh butter prepared from milk one day old. 
-व्यंसकः a roguish or dull-witted pupil.

__1 A temple in honour of Śiva. 
__2 A bee-hive of a conical form. 
__3 A king-fisher. 
-त्रिका Mushroom. 
-कम् A mushroom.

a. (-णी f.) Having or bearing an umbrella. -m. A barber.
